Okay, first off, this app SUCKS. like half of their algebra and graphing problems are WRONG. my sister majored in mathematics and she hates this app, because it is completely wrong. It says you can report a problem and almost every time, it’s the I case the answer is wrong or the problem makes absolutely no sense. The hints aren’t even hints. They make you count the question as WRONG when all you’re asking for is help, and they make you redo the entire unit test if you get 1 question wrong. If you search up for an example, 8th grade math, it shows you VIDEOS from the unit, and not the actual curriculum. It is so unorganized, terribly wrong, and all the kids that I tutor, teachers of classes that I’ve been to, absolutely HATES this app. It’s a waste of storage space, and is seriously useless. The videos don’t really help either bc it only covers a certain strategy of the quiz. I graduate school next year and I have pure hatred for this app for 16 years.

title: Phenomenal but tiresome
raw_text:
Phenomenal but tiresome
While Khan is absolutely phenomenal from the top down, I’d like a little more visibility with theorems, formulas, and rules. If I’m completing a lesson, instead of trying to remember the logic of how to solve that which was taught, it would be much more user friendly to start the lessons with a formula or a rule, than apply whatever obscure logic, at least you’d then have the formulas to fall back on. Maybe have a written portion to read along with the video examples. Also, the whole weird name thing is annoying. Don’t make me use brainpower at trying to understand how to properly pronounce some obscure name. Just use easy, short, and normal names i.e. Bob or Sue, not Jaquonalaysia. I understand you’re attempting inclusion, but it’s annoying and preachy. Keep the DEI out of math.
